findings.text: - **Commission on Human Rights (CHR):** An independent national human rights institution created under **Article XIII (Social Justice and Human Rights)** of the 1987 Constitution.

findings.text: A student is asked which article of the 1987 Constitution creates the Commission on Human Rights. Is it Article III, Article IX, or Article XIII?
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: 1. Article III of the 1987 Constitution is the Bill of Rights.
findings.problem: number in prose outside inline math

findings.text: 2. It contains 22 sections establishing fundamental civil and political liberties.
